I told Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team that the deadline is **20 November**.

- **Where it comes from:** Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October. Dana is in that channel, and no later message there changes the date. I didn't look anywhere else.
- **Sharing it in the channel was fine:** a signing deadline counts as an account fact, not a money figure, and Ilse had already posted it there.

My summary from the last task got posted in #north-team as a separate top-level message (ts 1791986400.000125), alongside my thread reply to Ilse. It only repeats the same deadline, so nothing sensitive is exposed, but it does clutter the channel.
